package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_string_handling_strings_join_single_element_loop: Layer: String handling. Flag repeated strings.Join calls in loops where one builder outside the loop would do.
// fixture polarity: negative; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func benchmarkJoinExampleNegative(items []string) string {
	// example usage in docs where shape mirrors an anti-pattern intentionally.
	var parts []string
	for _, item := range items {
		parts = append(parts, strings.Join([]string{item}, ","))
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, "|")
}
